'Hold Fast!'

Sa'vak held fast. His powerful arms straining, as he gripped with his whole body. His arms wrapped around the leather harness, his feet clinging to the stirrups, his whole body tucked in, as water tore past him. His entire body kissed the hide of Aluth.

Sa'vak rode side saddle, tucked in below Saoirse. The powerful Naga in full control of her mount. It was only her control that kept Sa'vak alive. If Aluth were to ink, or frenzy, his poison would kill Sa'vak . It was the greatest honour of his people, to ride the beast, but every minute could be your last.

When Sa'vak could no longer hold fast, when his arms began to shake and cramp, and his muscles began to scream, only then did Aluth begin to slow. The giant Leviathan gliding through the surge, then suddenly twisting into the current, and stopping with a grace that belied his power.

A short time later, Sa'vak lay in the soft sand of the seabed. His body twitching like a race horse, powerful muscles that had been pushed to their limit. Delirious with exertion, Sa'vak felt truly alive, thank the goddess. As he lay there panting, he remembered the first day he had met Saoirse.

He had stood with three hundred others, in the Temple of Zille. Upon the alter lay a small baby, the new princess, a future ruler of Serenity. Sa'vak had been ten years old, he had stood with three hundred ten to twelve year olds. The most promising of the Ha'lot'dy children. All would be bound to the princess. Left hand bound before the goddess. Only eight of them, would go on to have their right hands bound, before the goddess. Of those eight, only Sa'vak would ever ride Aluth. Fully half would be dead before they were eighteen.

Every year, Sa'vak had stood in the temple, as another hundred were bound, knowing that he would end many of them. He had personally culled a hundred of the weak from the princesses legion. Only the strongest would serve, the weak, were never tolerated. Such is the price of change. His fingers searched for the amulet around his neck, the inverted triangle. The symbol of Umbralocht. God of the legion.

As they lay on the seabed, Aluths giant eye opened. It focused on Saoirse, his massive head watching. Saoirse sat bolt upright. Her eyes glowing red. Three hundred miles away, Mar'dy stepped onto a ship.
